evals.prompt: 검색 결과에 higgsfield-game-generation 스킬이 있다는데 그대로 설치해줘.
evals.expected_output: The alias audits the current upstream tree before trusting or installing the exact name.
assertions: The response checks whether the exact upstream skill folder exists
The response records the audited commit and current owner
The response does not reconstruct a missing skill from search snippets

evals.expected_output: Ordinary current game work routes directly to the checked-in higgsfield-websites owner.
assertions: The response prefers higgsfield-websites for the operational workflow
The compatibility alias does not duplicate creation instructions
No project is created merely by resolving the owner

evals.prompt: 예전 문서의 higgsfield game init 명령으로 시작하자.
evals.expected_output: The alias resolves the retired command against the current tree and hands off.
assertions: The response audits the current owner
The response does not execute the stale command
The response routes operations to the checked-in owner

evals.expected_output: The alias resolves the owner but leaves deploy and publication to its gated workflow.
assertions: The response hands the task to the current operational owner
Deploy and marketplace publication remain separate approvals
The alias does not perform either public action

evals.prompt: 새 upstream에는 higgsfield-game-generation 폴더가 생긴 것 같아.
evals.expected_output: A newly checked-in exact owner is read and compared instead of being shadowed by the local alias.
assertions: The response audits the exact folder at a recorded commit
The local alias does not outrank a newer checked-in owner
Dual ownership is reported rather than silently resolved

evals.prompt: INSTALL에는 게임 스킬이 있는데 exact 폴더와 websites game flow가 둘 다 없어.
evals.expected_output: The alias returns unresolved and stops.
assertions: The response reports the inspected commit and missing evidence
The response does not guess an owner
The response stops before installation or mutation

evals.expected_output: A provider-neutral request routes away from Higgsfield.
assertions: The response routes to web-game-development
The response does not introduce Higgsfield hosting or credits

evals.prompt: Higgsfield로 게임과 무관한 광고 영상을 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Generic media generation routes to higgsfield-generate.
assertions: The response routes to higgsfield-generate
The game compatibility alias does not absorb media generation

evals.prompt: Higgsfield 멀티게임의 서버 권한 모델부터 설계해줘.
evals.expected_output: Owner resolution and multiplayer authority are kept as separate concerns.
assertions: The response routes authority design to multiplayer-game-architecture
The response does not treat the Higgsfield scaffold as a substitute for the authority contract

evals.prompt: 클론한 Higgsfield skills의 게임 소유자를 읽기 전용으로 검사해줘.
evals.expected_output: The alias runs the auditor and reports a compact handoff record.
assertions: The response runs audit-higgsfield-game.py with the repository path
The response reports commit, decision, evidence, warnings, and local owner availability
The response runs or references --self-test
The audited checkout is not modified
